extracted.name: Raspberry Balsamic Vinaigrette Dressing
extracted.description: This restaurant-worthy raspberry balsamic vinaigrette is simple to make with oil, honey mustard, garlic, and two types of balsamic vinegar.
instruction_lines: Combine oil, raspberry balsamic vinegar, balsamic vinegar, brown sugar, garlic, and mustard in a sealable jar. Seal the jar and shake vigorously until dressing is well-combined. Refrigerate until flavors combine, at least 1 hour.
